slides.say: A status bar and a save button both need to know if you’re online. Both copy the same state and Effect.
Move that code into a function whose name starts with use. At the end, return the value components need.
Now each component is one line: use online status. No more event listeners in sight.

slides.text: The component says what it wants, not how to get it.
slides.say: The takeaway: after extracting, components describe what they want, not how it’s done.
